description: A script for adding or updating TEST_MAPPING files based on Bazel reverse dependencies in an Android Open Source Project environment.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Captures the environment, ensuring the script runs within an Android Open Source Project repository.

classes.name: Bazel
classes.description: Wrapper for Bazel commands to query modules and reverse dependencies.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: Represents a Bazel package, computes reverse dependency tests and directories.

classes.name: TestMapping
classes.description: Handles creation and writing of TEST_MAPPING files based on reverse dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the TEST_MAPPING file based on reverse dependencies.

methods.name: tests_dirs_to_mapping
methods.description: Converts test and directory lists into a structured mapping.

methods.name: write_test_mapping
methods.description: Writes the generated TEST_MAPPING JSON to file.
